text:
- **Question answering:** Ask-tool questions can now be answered on the site as well as in chat. The first answer wins. Question endings now come from hook events, not transcript reads.
- **CI and test reliability:** The AGENTS.md check now gives the same verdict on every rerun. Pull requests grade AGENTS.md in diff mode, and full grading runs daily on main. `make test-go` passes on every run because the service test takes a free port from the kernel.
- **Pm release and repo setup:** This repo now uses the newest pm release, and the service runs on it. pm no longer installs a git hook or sets the git hooks path. Claude Code no longer saves or loads auto memory in this repo.
- **Record layer design:** The owner chose Model A for the record layer. The project records now hold this decision as an owner decision. The record drafts page states the final design.
